dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...And that's the alchemical transmutation process. What do you think? Would you like to try it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I... still can't remember the formula from just now. If I damage the crafting bench...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: For small-scale work like this, failure will only result in the loss of materials.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Besides, losing materials is an unavoidable part of learning alchemy.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. After all, "alchemy" counts as "common sense" in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Durin happens to be interested in this, too. Although the... environment here is somewhat rudimentary, it's good enough to teach some basic formulas.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Hmm, I wrote down all the formulas Albedo taught me. There are so many numbers and symbols, it feels like I'm trudging through mud...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: When it comes to learning, how fast you go isn't what matters. What matters most is laying a solid foundation every step of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...It looks like we've used up most of our materials. For now, let's head back and retrieve some more.
